note: Illinois DNR park at Cairo Point, the Ohio/Mississippi confluence, run from Horseshoe Lake-Alexander. Small non-modern campground, 8 sites with electric: camp in the grassy area or on pavement down by the water; self-register. FLOOD-PRONE - the road closes during high water; call ahead. --Claude
